records.name: Ballet at Penn
records.summary: A ballet group for Penn students at any skill level. It offers free weekly open classes and an audition-based company that rehearses each semester for a show.
records.what_you_do: Take a free open class each week, or audition for the Performance Company and rehearse for its semester show. Email the club to get on its list.

schedule.text: Free open classes each week, and a Performance Company show each semester.

cost.text: Weekly open classes are free. Performance Company costs are not stated.

first_step.how: Come to a free weekly open class. To join the Performance Company, audition for it each semester.
first_step.basis: Open classes are free and welcome any level, but the company needs an audition.

records.notes: Directory status reads INACTIVE and says the club is not accepting members, but the club's own site lists a show dated April 25, 2026. Confirm the open classes and audition details with the club before promoting.

records.name: Beyond Arrests: Re-Thinking Systematic-Oppression (BARS)
records.summary: A Penn student group that pushes to shrink the reach of the criminal legal system. It hosts talks and workshops, takes part in local advocacy and mutual aid, and invites speakers who have lived through incarceration.
records.what_you_do: Join discussions and workshops, help with local organizing and mutual aid, and take part in the club's yearly conference. Follow the club on Instagram or email it to connect.

first_step.how: Follow the club on Instagram, or email it to connect. The club's Join Our Team page explains how to get involved.
first_step.basis: The club says new people are always welcome and points to a page on how to join.

records.notes: Posts dated November 2025 are read from their web addresses, since the page text gives no full date. Directory status reads INACTIVE, which conflicts with those posts. The barsorg.com address redirects to a wordpress address, which was followed once. Confirm before promoting.

records.name: Biomedical Engineering Society (BMES)

records.what_you_do: Come to the society's social and career events, and sign up for its list. When recruiting opens, apply through the join form.

first_step.basis: The site links an application to join, and it does not say whether events are open to all.

records.name: Black Designers Society
records.summary: A group for Black students in planning and design at Penn. It offers mentorship, pushes for fairer policies in the field, and connects current students, prospective students and alumni.
records.what_you_do: Go to any of the society's events, which count as taking part, and follow its Instagram or LinkedIn page for updates.

first_step.how: Go to any of the society's events. Email the club to ask how to join.
first_step.basis: Events are open to students, but the directory says the club is not accepting members right now.

records.notes: No website and no dated items. Directory status reads UNDER REVIEW, active flag true, not accepting members. Probably active only because the directory listing is active. The community tag comes from the directory's description of supporting Black students.

records.name: Black Graduate and Professional Student Assembly
records.summary: Supports graduate and professional students with roots in the African Diaspora at Penn. It helps with academic, social, political and cultural needs, and helps newcomers settle in. Allies from any background are welcome too.
records.what_you_do: Join the group chat, come to socials and campus events, and email with questions.

records.name: Black Muslims at Penn
records.summary: A community for Black Muslim students at Penn and at other universities. It works to unite people from across the African Diaspora, deepen Islamic learning, and support charity and service.

first_step.how: Join the GroupMe, which the club links from its Instagram.
first_step.basis: The directory lists an application as required, though joining the GroupMe is the stated way in.

records.notes: No website and no dated items. Directory status reads UNDER REVIEW, active flag true. Probably active only because the directory listing is active. The community and faith tags come from the directory description of the club.

records.name: Bloomers Comedy

notes: Read all 20 clubs from their Penn Clubs directory entries and checked each club's own website once where one is listed. Two sites redirected and were followed once (barsorg.com and bmes.seas.upenn.edu). Result: 14 records are publishable and 6 are held back as status unknown: Bangla Society, Beekeeping Club, BioArt Lab, Bioethics Society, BGSA and Black Student League. The six are held because the directory status reads INACTIVE and no dated activity was found on a club site. Directory status words such as UNDER REVIEW and PRELIMINARY were read as registration state, not activity, so clubs with the directory active flag and no dated item are probably_active. Active on dated evidence: Ballet at Penn (show dated April 2026 on its site), Beyond Arrests (posts dated November 2025, read from web addresses), Blockchain at Penn (March 27 and 28, 2026 event weekend), Body Empowerment (Fall 2026 recruitment, year only). Probably active on a dated 2024 post: Black Graduate and Professional Student Assembly (post dates read from web addresses). The Black Student League website did not resolve and was not retried. Personal emails and phone numbers of officers on directory entries and club sites were not recorded. Directory emails that look like individual Penn addresses were left out. The Bulgarian Society directory Instagram link uses an account name that does not match the club, so it was left out. Linktree pages (Bangla Society, BlackGen Capital, BioArt Lab) were not read because they are link lists. No WebSearch was used. Fetches: 43, under the cap of 60. No rate limiting was seen.
